name: anymd
tagline: Convert PDF, Office, EPUB, HTML, images (OCR), and audio/video into clean Markdown locally — no API key.
description: Fast local Rust MCP server (`@sylphx/anymd`) that turns PDF, Word (.docx), PowerPoint (.pptx), Excel (.xlsx/.xls/.ods), CSV/TSV, EPUB, HTML and web URLs, images (OCR), and audio/video (metadata, subtitles, local transcripts) into clean, token-lean Markdown with page citation anchors. Runs locally on your machine with no API key required. Exposes four MCP tools: `outline` (heading tree navigation), `read` (paginated Markdown conversion with token budgets and cursors), `search` (literal and BM25-ranked search across files, folders, and URLs), and `inspect` (page rendering, region extraction, OCR, structure JSON, and document comparison).

install.notes: Requires Node.js 18+. Runs locally over stdio with no API key required. Optionally pass --allow-dir=/path/to/docs (or set MCP_PDF_ALLOWED_DIRS) to confine file access to specific directories.
